description: Checker at 11, dice [6,2]. Point 3 (destinations for both second moves) is blocked. Both dice individually give 1 move; larger die (6) must be used.
notes: Die-6: 11→5 open, then die-2: 5→3 blocked (1 move). Die-2: 11→9 open, then die-6: 9→3 blocked (1 move). Both individually work, not together. Larger die (6) wins: 11/5.
